heroSummary: Jordan high-school students begin Tuesday, August 19, 2025, while seventh graders attend orientation. Elementary students and grades 8–9 begin August 20. Seventh grade ends June 3, one day before the June 4 last day for most students. The calendar includes 180 instructional days across four quarters and a Health & Wellness Virtual Day February 6.
calendarNotes: Jordan high-school students begin August 19, the same day seventh graders attend orientation; elementary students and grades 8–9 begin August 20. The official calendar totals 180 days across quarters of 43, 47, 47, and 43 days. Fall secondary conferences occur September 24–25, while elementary conferences occur October 1–2, with level-specific compensation and professional days afterward. February 6 is a Health & Wellness Virtual Day rather than a normal in-person school day. Winter Recess runs December 22–January 2 and Spring Recess runs March 31–April 3 after a March 30 grade-transmittal day. High-school Pre-ACT/college-prep and ACT dates assign different attendance rules by grade and were marked subject to change. Seventh grade ends June 3, high-school graduation is June 2–3, and most students finish June 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When did Jordan School District start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: High-school students started Tuesday, August 19, 2025, and seventh graders attended orientation. Elementary students and grades 8–9 started Wednesday, August 20.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Jordan School District Fall Recess in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Recess was October 21–24, 2025. Students also had no school October 20 for grade transmittal and returned October 27.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Jordan School District Winter Recess in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Recess ran December 22, 2025, through January 2, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: What was Jordan's Health & Wellness Virtual Day?
calendarFaqs.a: February 6, 2026 was a virtual day for all levels. Students did not attend in person and followed school directions for virtual participation.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Jordan School District Spring Recess in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Recess was March 31–April 3, 2026, after a no-school grade-transmittal day March 30. Classes resumed April 6.

calendarFaqs.q: When was the last day in Jordan School District in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Seventh grade ended June 3. Elementary, grades 8–9, and high school ended Thursday, June 4, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: How many school days were in Jordan's 2025–26 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official quarter counts were 43, 47, 47, and 43 days, totaling 180 instructional days.

calendarFaqs.q: Was the supplied 2025–26 local PDF an official district PDF?
calendarFaqs.a: No. It displays Jordan dates but was designed for a real-estate advertiser and has Canyon in its file metadata. This page uses the official Jordan all-level PDF discovered in the district upload archive as its primary source.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 10, 2026, against the complete official three-page Jordan archive PDF and the supplied one-page third-party companion calendar.
sourceReviewDetailsTitle: How we verified the archived Jordan calendar
sourceReviewDetails: Although no 2025-2026 URL was supplied, the official three-page all-level calendar remains available in Jordan's own Planning & Enrollment upload archive and is used as the primary source.
The official PDF identifies grade-level openings, all-level closures, conferences, virtual and testing dates, graduation, staggered last days, quarter counts, and the emergency make-up rule.
The PDF was visually checked because A/B letters, color-coded exceptions, and calendar legends lose context in plain-text extraction.

The cover says updated September 3, 2025, while later calendar-grid pages say last updated May 15, 2025; the newer cover date is used for the source version and the internal difference is preserved here.
The supplied local PDF says Jordan School District but includes Move Utah Real Estate branding and has the metadata title 2025-2026 Canyon school calendar, so it is treated only as a companion check.
The recurring elementary early-out note comes from that companion calendar and is explicitly labeled as supporting guidance rather than official-PDF content.
High-school testing dates retain the official subject-to-change wording and grade-specific attendance rules.
The .ics file is a one-time import and does not update automatically or reproduce every A/B and elementary early-out date.
sourceMaintainerText: MySchoolDates Calendar Data Team using official Jordan School District sources.
